title.zh: 理想导体边界磁通修正

summary: Find boundary-source currents by truncated-SVD least squares and apply their Green-response correction to a field-flux vector.

identity.relation: sampled uncorrected flux and boundary Green response to equivalent source currents and corrected field flux
identity.direction: field flux, sampling matrix and two Green matrices -> currents, corrections and boundary residual
identity.definition: Let b = S @ psi, Gbb be the boundary-source to boundary-sample Green matrix, and Gbf the same sources to field points. Compute I = -pinv_rcond(Gbb) @ b using singular values strictly greater than rcond times the largest singular value. Return psi + Gbf @ I and residual b + Gbb @ I, with the intermediate currents, corrections, singular values and effective rank.
identity.model: linear ideal-conductor boundary-flux correction with a truncated-SVD Green inverse
identity.geometry: caller-defined field points, boundary samples and boundary-source basis
identity.coordinates: vector/matrix sample order supplied by the caller; no R-Z coordinates are accepted by this callable
identity.boundary: Boundary cancellation is limited to the retained singular subspace; residual need not vanish for rank-deficient or truncated responses.
assumptions: For the P4 axisymmetric per-radian chain, supply psi=R A_phi and both Green matrices in Wb/rad per ampere; the linear algebra also accepts complete Wb only if the field flux and both Green matrices are converted together.
S samples flux at the boundary and is dimensionless in the documented SI contract.
For the returned field-flux correction to have the reported boundary residual when sampled, S @ Gbf equals Gbb under the caller's ordering and units.
The two Green matrices use the same boundary-source current basis.

inputs.name: uncorrected_field_flux
inputs.description: Psi=R A_phi before boundary-source correction at caller-defined field points.
inputs.constraints: Finite one-dimensional vector; length equals the columns of boundary_sample_matrix and rows of green_boundary_to_field.

inputs.name: boundary_sample_matrix
inputs.description: Linear map from field flux to sampled boundary flux.
inputs.constraints: Finite two-dimensional matrix; column count equals N_field and row count equals green_boundary_to_boundary rows.

inputs.name: green_boundary_to_boundary
inputs.description: Psi response at boundary samples per unit boundary-source current.
inputs.constraints: Finite nonempty two-dimensional matrix; shares its source columns with green_boundary_to_field.

inputs.name: green_boundary_to_field
inputs.description: Psi response at field points per unit boundary-source current.
inputs.constraints: Finite two-dimensional matrix; row count equals N_field and column count equals N_source.

inputs.name: rcond
inputs.description: Relative cutoff for singular values of the boundary Green matrix.
inputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; values above one are allowed and can retain no singular values.

outputs.name: corrected_field_flux
outputs.description: Uncorrected field psi plus Gbf @ boundary_currents.

outputs.name: boundary_currents
outputs.description: Equivalent source-current coefficients from the truncated pseudoinverse.

outputs.name: boundary_flux_correction
outputs.constraints: Uses the boundary-sample order of Gbb.

outputs.name: singular_values
outputs.description: Boundary Green singular values in descending order.
outputs.constraints: From the reduced SVD of Gbb.

outputs.name: effective_rank
outputs.description: Count of singular values strictly above the relative cutoff.

outputs.name: residual
outputs.description: Original sampled boundary psi plus boundary-source correction.
outputs.constraints: Equals S @ uncorrected_field_flux + Gbb @ boundary_currents; may be nonzero.

outputs.name: residual_norm
outputs.description: Euclidean norm of the boundary residual.
outputs.constraints: Nonnegative; may be nonzero after truncation or incompatible boundary flux.

preconditions: All matrices and vectors have the documented shared sample and source ordering and consistent Wb/rad/A Green units; a full-Wb conversion must rescale both Green matrices and the field flux together.
The caller supplies physically meaningful Green responses and a boundary sampling matrix.
supported: Finite-dimensional linear boundary-flux correction with an explicitly observable truncated-SVD residual.
excluded: Automatic geometry construction or Green-matrix calculation.
A guarantee of zero residual for incompatible or truncated systems.
Nonlinear wall response or time-dependent conductor dynamics.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for nonfinite or wrong-rank arrays, shape mismatch, empty Gbb, or a negative/nonfinite numeric rcond.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: NumPy SVD or arithmetic errors propagate; the implementation does not validate finiteness of computed outputs after matrix operations.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: No iterative convergence check; SVD may fail with a NumPy linear-algebra error.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No result dictionary is returned when validation or SVD fails; a successful result may retain a nonzero boundary residual.

provenance.lineage_summary: Maintained SciRel relation mapped to a saved Pleiades L1 operator and direct tests. The historical admission mapping is development provenance only, not approval in the current SciRel lifecycle.

example.description: Cancel two sampled boundary fluxes in a full-rank, sampling-consistent toy system.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.field import correct_ideal_conductor_boundary_flux
psi = np.array([3.0, -1.0, 2.0])
S = np.array([[1.0, 0.0, 0.0], [0.0, 0.5, 0.5]])
Gbb = np.diag([2.0, 4.0])
Gbf = np.array([[2.0, 0.0], [-1.0, 3.0], [1.0, 5.0]])
assert np.allclose(S @ Gbf, Gbb)
result = correct_ideal_conductor_boundary_flux(psi, S, Gbb, Gbf)
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['corrected_field_flux'], [0.0, 0.125, -0.125])
np.testing.assert_allclose(result['residual'], 0.0)
assert result['effective_rank'] == 2
example.expected: The full-rank solve returns corrected psi [0, 0.125, -0.125] Wb/rad and zero sampled boundary residual within floating-point tolerance.

scope: Full-rank cancellation and sampling-consistent corrected field flux.
Consistent 2*pi rescaling of the flux and both Green matrices preserves equivalent boundary currents.
Relative singular-value cutoff and effective rank.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct SciRel tests verify a small full-rank consistent system and one truncated-rank case, not arbitrary boundary Green data, conditioning guarantees, physical wall correctness or expert recognition of this development record.
known_limitations: The implementation checks matrix dimensions but does not check S @ Gbf = Gbb; callers must establish that physical coupling separately.
Truncation can leave a nonzero residual.
No geometric or source Green construction is included.
Public distribution licensing and SciRel expert recognition remain pending.
